page.overview:
Who is Duke of Limesnatch?

Duke of Limesnatch is a character who is seen listed on a chart in Issue 5. He is considered to be "lawful neutral." His origins are likely similar to the Earl of Lemongrab's. His name is based on Lemongrab's—instead of Earl it is Duke, instead of Lemon it is Lime, and instead of grab it is snatch. Lemongrab's name originally was supposed to be Lemonsnatch, but the studio changed it to Lemongrab. It is possible the Duke of Limesnatch's name was based on Lemongrab's original name.
